ruleName: Playing the ball as it lies
group: Playing the ball as it lies
title: What should you do if you find your ball in a tricky spot?
question: You find your ball in some long grass, but it’s still on the course and in play. What do the rules say you must do?

choices.text: Move the ball to a better spot to make your shot easier
Play the ball exactly as it is, without moving or touching it
Pick up the ball to clean it before playing
Let someone else move the ball for you

explanation: You must play the ball as it lies, unless a specific rule lets you do something else. Moving or cleaning the ball in play is not allowed unless a rule says so.
